description: Project-authored five-layer research score. It is a system operationalization, not an official Serenity or Leopold Aschenbrenner scoring model.

L2_supply_chain_bottleneck.description: Potential bottleneck, pricing power and replacement difficulty

L3_company_quality.description: Margins, cash flow, leverage and financing quality

L4_valuation_catalyst.description: Valuation evidence, dated catalysts and expectation gap

L5_evidence_risk.description: Primary-source evidence, data completeness, thesis risk and disconfirmation

user_overlay.description: An optional local user's holding-horizon overlay is evaluated separately, remains outside Git and does not affect the five-layer research score.
